evaluation_phase: Phase 3B: Updated Model Training & Chronological Evaluation
evaluation_regime: One-step-ahead chronological evaluation on actual preceding-year lags
evaluation_distinction: One-step-ahead evaluation provides the model with observed historical actuals for t-1 and t-2 at each annual step. In contrast, Stage 9 Phase 2 backtesting evaluated recursive multi-step forecasting where future lags were iteratively replaced by model predictions without intervening ground-truth corrections.

best_overall_method.name: Naïve Persistence Baseline
best_overall_method.justification: Naïve Persistence achieved the lowest prediction error on held-out test data because Indian wholesale input prices entered a prolonged macro plateau between FY 2022-23 and FY 2025-26, rendering zero-change persistence highly effective numerically for one-step-ahead forecasts.

best_machine_learning_model.name: Ridge Regression (alpha=1.0)
best_machine_learning_model.justification: Ridge Regression achieved the lowest RMSE (15.07 pts) and MAE (12.85 pts) among all machine learning estimators, substantially outperforming tree ensembles (Random Forest RMSE 26.65, Gradient Boosting RMSE 27.08) by over 11.5 pts. L2 shrinkage regularizes collinear lagged features without overreacting to small sample fluctuations.

methodological_comparison_with_backtesti.backtesting_scope: Stage 9 Phase 2 recursive multi-step forecasts from 2022-23 baseline
methodological_comparison_with_backtesti.phase_3b_scope: Phase 3B one-step-ahead regression using actual observed preceding lags

persistence_comparison.explanation: In one-step-ahead, Persistence updates each year to the true preceding year actual; in multi-year backtesting it froze at 2022-23.

ridge_comparison.explanation: Ridge RMSE improved from 20.28 in recursive backtesting to 15.07 in one-step-ahead because error compounding was eliminated.

drift_comparison.explanation: Drift exploded in recursive backtesting (RMSE 66.09) due to compounding post-COVID slope extrapolation, but was bounded in one-step-ahead.
